topology_reasoning.orientation: Calibration (prepare_calibration) shows the image X axis (4800px, bbox 4145px) maps to the 120um LENGTH, and image Y axis (3584px) maps to the 4um WIDTH -- i.e. the device is drawn with propagation along the horizontal image axis and only 4um tall (transverse) in total.
topology_reasoning.cross_section_along_width: Scanning the image along Y (width) at a fixed length position reveals 7 bands, symmetric about the width center: margin(white) - comb_outer1(5 fine fingers) - pad1(solid) - comb_mid(5 fine fingers) - pad2(solid) - comb_outer2(5 fine fingers) - margin(white). Measured band heights (px, /896 px/um): margin=686/683px (~0.76um), comb_outer=447/450px (~0.50um), pad=420/418px (~0.47um), comb_mid=480px (~0.54um).
topology_reasoning.length_envelope: Along the length (X) axis, material extent is NOT uniform: the mid comb (between the two pads) spans the full 120um bbox (inset ~0). The pads are shorter, inset ~7.6-7.9um symmetrically from each end (length ~104-105um). The outer combs (between a pad and the outer margin) show a linear taper: the finger adjacent to a pad is shortest (inset ~6.7-6.8um), the finger adjacent to the outer margin is longest (inset ~5.7um) -- this taper produces the fanned/sloped silhouette visible in the raw image (a trapezoid-looking envelope funneling into the solid pad).
topology_reasoning.function: This reads as a 3-lane parallel finger array (5 fingers per lane, 15 total transverse channels) bridged by two solid access/bus sections (pads), with the outer two finger-arrays apodized (linearly chirped end-position / effective length) approaching each pad -- consistent with a chirped/apodized grating-coupler-like or fan-in/fan-out transition structure. Recreation targets the geometry as drawn (primitives only), not a specific named device.
function_defining_knobs: tooth_width_um / tooth_gap_um (transverse pitch of the finger array -- grating/coupling pitch)
pad_length_um (solid access-waveguide length between comb arrays)
taper_inset_near_pad_um / taper_inset_near_margin_um (defines the chirp/apodization slope of the outer comb arrays)
comb_outer_width_band_um / pad_width_band_um / comb_mid_width_band_um (transverse space allocated to each band)

iterations.change_made: First pass: formulaic model -- margin band left empty, each comb band's 5 teeth placed via a fixed period (tooth_width+gap) with a linear length-taper interpolated across the 5 tooth indices between two flat endpoint insets. Pads and comb bands sized from averaged measured band heights.

Tried extending the outermost finger of each outer comb array all the way to the width edge (y=0 / y=total_width) as a SOLID stacked-rectangle taper, to capture the faint curved silhouette visible there. Regressed badly: pixel fill-fraction check at y=0..650px showed only ~5% black (a thin hollow outline, not solid material), so filling it solid added large false-positive area. Reverted.

Reverted iter-2's solid extension. Replaced the formulaic period/taper model with the exact measured per-tooth and per-pad transverse (y) boundaries and length insets read directly off the binary image (segment boundaries + main_extent per row), keeping the margin bands empty as in iter 1. This closed most of the remaining precision gap -- stopped here, IoU exceeds the 0.85 target.
